name: DNSCrypt Proxy
description: Smart DNS filtering with DNSCrypt. Local resolver on 127.0.0.1:5354 with per-profile blocklists (HaGeZi Light/Normal/PRO/PRO++/Ultimate), wildcard-aware Custom Rules, bilingual WebUI (EN/AR), JSON metrics Dashboard, and offline-capable PWA. Zero telemetry.
author: gasciljh

shortcuts.name: Control Panel
shortcuts.description: Open the WebUI landing page (same origin as the manifest)

shortcuts.name: Monitoring Dashboard
shortcuts.description: Open the Dashboard landing page (same origin as the manifest)

x-note-version: Mirrors VERSION (SSOT). Checked by .github/workflows/ci.yml 'Verify version consistency'.
x-note-companion-apk: The companion Android app is served at GET /app-debug.apk (public, no auth, 404 when absent) with Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600, immutable. NOT referenced in icons, shortcuts, or the SW precache list — it is a build artifact, not a PWA asset. Size ~3 MB. Min Android: 5.0 (API 21). Source: gasciljh/dnscrypt-proxy-app (separate repo). Version pinned in proxy/app-apk.version (SSOT). The .sha256 sidecar is staged by release.yml for verification by install_app.sh at install time. Tracked-file model: 96 tracked + 0-11 gitignored artifacts (96-107 total).
x-note-shortcuts: Shortcut URLs MUST be same-origin with the manifest's start_url. WebUI (9090) and Dashboard (9091) are different origins → a single manifest CANNOT provide cross-origin shortcuts. Both use RELATIVE URLs that resolve to the manifest's CURRENT origin. When installed from 9090, both shortcuts open the WebUI; from 9091, both open the Dashboard. For reliable cross-origin navigation, the WebUI provides a dynamic Dashboard link built from /api?action=runtime_info.
x-note-docs: Full per-release history, corrections lineage, and technical trade-offs live in docs/MANIFEST_NOTES.md. Key references: docs/BACKUP.md, docs/EMERGENCY.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/API.md, docs/SECURITY.md, CHANGELOG.md.
